service.detailBody:
Men's health concerns are consistently under-reported across all populations — not because men do not experience them, but because the combination of stigma, time pressure, and access barriers makes seeking help feel difficult. A confidential video consultation with a CMR-registered doctor removes several of these barriers simultaneously: no waiting room, no need to explain yourself to a receptionist, no travel to a clinic, and — for those who prefer it — the option to consult in English, Romanian.

They should. Because in the vast majority of cases, these are medical conditions with medical causes — and medical solutions.

Our doctors, registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR), offer confidential men's health assessments by secure video call in English. No waiting room, no language barrier, no discomfort of an in-person consultation for a sensitive concern. Just a full clinical assessment and a clear plan, same day, from anywhere in Romania.

Who This Service Is For

This consultation is appropriate for adult men with:

  • Erectile dysfunction — new onset or worsening
  • Reduced libido or loss of interest in sexual activity
  • Premature or delayed ejaculation
  • Performance anxiety with clinical impact
  • Symptoms of testosterone deficiency — fatigue, mood changes, reduced muscle mass, weight gain
  • Hormonal imbalance affecting energy, mood, weight, or sexual function
  • Sexual dysfunction related to diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or medication

General men's health concerns — cardiovascular risk, metabolic health, hair loss with hormonal basis

A need for investigation requests — testosterone panel, cardiovascular risk assessment, metabolic profile

Why Erectile Dysfunction Deserves Clinical Assessment

Erectile dysfunction is not simply a lifestyle inconvenience. It is one of the most reliable early warning signs of underlying cardiovascular disease — often presenting years before a cardiac event. It is also strongly associated with diabetes, hypertension, testosterone deficiency, and medication side effects.

A man who treats erectile dysfunction as an embarrassing inconvenience rather than a clinical signal is missing an important opportunity for early intervention on conditions that, left unaddressed, carry serious long-term health consequences.

The clinical history is the most powerful diagnostic tool in men's health — and a full history can be taken by video call. Our doctors assess the complete clinical picture, not just the presenting symptom.

What Your Consultation Includes

Full clinical assessmentYour doctor reviews your symptoms in detail, medical history, current medications, cardiovascular risk factors, hormonal indicators, psychological contributors, and lifestyle factors — building a complete clinical picture of what is causing your symptoms.

Identification of underlying causesMen's health symptoms rarely exist in isolation. Erectile dysfunction, for example, is frequently an early marker of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or testosterone deficiency. Your doctor assesses the complete clinical picture — not just the presenting complaint.

Clinical management planBased on the assessment, your doctor advises on appropriate next steps — which may include lifestyle and metabolic optimisation, investigation requests for blood tests or hormonal assessment, clinical recommendations at the doctor's professional discretion, or referral to urology or endocrinology where indicated.

Electronic prescription — where clinically appropriateWhen clinically indicated, your doctor issues an electronic prescription through the Romanian Electronic Prescription System (SIPE). You present it at any pharmacy of your choice in Romania.

Note: Special-regime prescriptions covering certain controlled medications cannot be transmitted electronically under Romanian law. Your doctor advises if this applies to your situation.

Referral and investigation coordinationWhen specialist referral or blood tests are clinically indicated, your doctor issues the relevant documentation on the same day.

Conditions Commonly Assessed

  • Sexual health and function
  • Erectile dysfunction — assessment of medical, vascular, hormonal, and psychological factors
  • Premature and delayed ejaculation
  • Reduced libido and loss of interest in sexual activity
  • Performance anxiety with clinical impact
  • Sexual dysfunction related to diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or medication
  • Hormonal and metabolic
  • Testosterone deficiency — symptoms, assessment, and management pathway
  • Hormonal imbalance affecting energy, mood, weight, and sexual function
  • Metabolic syndrome and its impact on men's health
  • Weight-related hormonal disruption
  • General men's health
  • Cardiovascular risk assessment in men
  • Fatigue, low energy, and mood changes with hormonal or metabolic cause
  • Hair loss with hormonal basis
  • Prostate health concerns and referral where indicated
  • General health assessments and preventive care for men

Confidentiality

Everything discussed during your consultation is confidential and protected under Romanian and European data protection law — including Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Romanian Law no. 190/2018 on personal data processing.

Your consultation is conducted by encrypted video call. Nobody at your workplace, in your household, or in your social circle needs to know you booked an appointment. Your health records are protected under strict data protection standards. Information is not shared without your explicit consent, except in the limited circumstances required by law.

Men's Health in Romania — Why This Service

Men's health concerns are consistently under-reported across all populations — but for expats and international residents in Romania, there is an additional barrier: navigating a sensitive conversation about sexual health or hormonal symptoms in a language that is not your own, with a doctor you have never met before, in a system you do not fully understand.

Our service removes all of these barriers. A CMR-registered doctor, consulting in English, available from anywhere in Romania, same day, with complete clinical confidentiality.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this a prescription service?No. This is a clinical assessment service. Our doctors conduct a full clinical assessment and advise on appropriate management based on clinical findings. Any clinical recommendations — including prescriptions where clinically indicated — are made at the doctor's professional discretion following full assessment.

Can erectile dysfunction really be assessed by video call?Yes — for the vast majority of presentations. The clinical history is the most powerful diagnostic tool in men's health and a full history can be taken by video call. Your doctor also assesses lifestyle factors, cardiovascular risk, hormonal indicators, and psychological contributors during the call. Where physical examination findings are needed that cannot be assessed remotely, your doctor advises on appropriate in-person assessment.

What blood tests might be needed?Depending on your presentation, your doctor may request a testosterone panel, cardiovascular risk assessment, fasting glucose, HbA1c, thyroid function, and metabolic profile. Investigation requests can be coordinated in the same consultation.

Is this service suitable for younger men?Yes. Erectile dysfunction and other men's health concerns can arise in men from their twenties — often with psychological or lifestyle causes at younger ages. This service is appropriate for adult men of all ages.

What if my condition requires specialist input?If your assessment indicates that specialist input is needed — urology, endocrinology, or cardiology — your doctor advises clearly and coordinates the referral on the same day.

Can I use this service if I do not have a Romanian family doctor?Yes. This service is available to all men in Romania — including expats and international residents without a registered Romanian family doctor.

Do I need Romanian health insurance?No. This is a private-pay service. Prescriptions issued through this service are dispensed at full private cost regardless of insurance status.
